scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && node scripts/copy-client-dist.mjs && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace=client && npm run check --workspace=server
scripts.test:local: npm test --workspace=client && npm run test:unit --workspace=server && npm run test:integration --workspace=server
scripts.verify:local: npm run check && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=moderate --workspaces && npm run test:local
